title: Meld Partnership! | COPICafe Episode 35 | Cornucopias
description:
Meld CEO Ken Olling, Upcoming NFT Mints, Racing Game Discussion and some face-melting Leaks!

In this episode of COPICafe Josh and Rob discuss building in the bear market and recap the successful Bobble Head test mint. They also discuss building the racing game alongside the main game. The guys then lay out the details of the upcoming Cheeky Crypto racing suite NFT mint and the vehicle light kit NFT Sale. They're then joined by the Ken Olling, CEO of Meld, a defi project building on Cardano. The episode wraps up with a handful of incredible visual LEAKS!

00:00 - Introduction
00:40 - Beverage Choices
01:58 - Building in a Bear Market
05:12 - Bobble Head Test  Mint
08:27 -  Racing Game
13:08 - Upcoming NFT Mints
16:54 - Special Guest - Ken Olling, CEO, Meld
36:22 - LEAKS!

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw

#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
